text_block_list.text: (Tap... tap)

On Christmas morning, I woke to the sound 
of something tapping on the window. When I 
opened the curtains—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Please come down! It's a white 
Christmas!

Matikanetannhauser was waving, a snowball 
in one hand.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Hyo~! A winter wonderland, both above and 
below~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
And on Christmas, no less! Could anything 
possibly be happier than this!?

Matikanetannhauser is thrilled, looking 
just like a happy puppy. That said, it 
really is freezing. As she stomps her feet 
to keep warm――
(Thud...)

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hehe, you left an opening!
I got hit by a snowball.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, you're completely covered in snow, 
Trainer!

I can't just keep letting myself be a 
target. Rolling up a handy snowball, I 
throw it—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
—Oof! Oh, now you've done it~! Take this, 
then... Yaaah! Take that! Take that! 
Ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa, haa... Hehehe, snowball fights 
are so much fun~.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"...Or rather, you can be surprisingly 
childish, Trainer. Fufufu."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Haaah, what should I do next?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, right! Come here for a second, 
Trainer!"

Where I was taken, a small snowman was 
standing.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I was making it before calling for you, 
Trainer! A Trainer snowman!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I actually called you over to show you 
this, but I completely forgot!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Look, doesn't this part kinda look like 
it? Like the look in the eyes, you know~?

Come to think of it, it does kind of feel 
like it captures some of the 
characteristics.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ehe! It took quite a bit of time~.

"She seems to have worked really hard. 
Since she did, I'd like to give her 
something in return."
choice_data_list: Then I'll make a snowman of you!
Then I'll make a snowman of you.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Mine!?

A few hours later... After much trial and 
error, we finished a snowman that looked 
reasonably like her.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Wah! Thank you very much! It looks just 
like me! ...I think!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Hey, since we're here, let's line them up 
together!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, so cute~! ...I wish it wouldn't 
melt.

I was able to spend a truly memorable day 
with Machikane Tannhauser.

Where I was taken, an igloo stood all by 
itself.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I was making it before calling for you, 
Trainer! A little snow hut!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I actually called you over to show you 
this, but I completely forgot about it, 
ahaha.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like, why don't you step in? It's 
surprisingly warm~.

Stepping inside as told... it was quite 
cramped, yet gave a strange sense of 
comfort.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. It really makes you want to toast 
some mochi here and eat it, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Still, they say snow absorbs sound, but it 
really is quiet inside an igloo.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
It's warm, quiet, beautiful, ...and my 
Trainer is right beside me...

—And Matikanetannhauser nestled close, 
resting her head on my shoulder.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Fufu, this is so calming...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Can we stay like this just a little 
longer?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: ...Yay.

Afterward, snow began to fall silently... 
and the two of us enjoyed the snowy 
landscape for a while.
